name: STAC Electro-Optical Extension Ontology
title: Definitions for STAC Electro-Optical (EO) extension elements
description: Vocabulary defining the elements of the STAC EO extension (eo:cloud_cover, eo:snow_cover, eo:common_name, eo:center_wavelength, eo:full_width_half_max, eo:solar_illumination), providing Linked Data terms for the STAC EO schema. eo:common_name's fixed 20-value enumeration is modeled as a skos:ConceptScheme (eo:CommonBandNameScheme); the remaining fields stay OWL datatype properties. Reuses STAC core classes rather than redefining them.
